# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (specific reporting line not stated) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s partner opportunity centers on making enterprise AI deployments scalable without sacrificing technical rigor,
customer confidence, or responsible-use standards.

This is likely a high-leverage leadership role at the intersection of ecosystem strategy, solution quality, and customer
outcomes. Success will depend on creating a repeatable operating system for partner-led technical work while retaining
strong feedback loops into internal product, engineering, and commercial teams.

The core tension is scale versus consistency: external delivery capacity can expand reach dramatically, but only if partners
can apply clear architectural, governance, adoption, and escalation patterns.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is an AI research and product company founded in 2021 and structured as a public-benefit corporation. Its
positioning emphasizes AI that is dependable, understandable, and controllable, with Claude serving business and developer
use cases.

The company combines frontier-model work with an enterprise platform motion. That creates a demanding operating model:
commercial teams must translate fast-moving capabilities into practical value for organizations with complex data,
security, workflow, and change-management needs.

Anthropic’s differentiation is not limited to model performance. Trust, safety, and deployment quality are likely material
to how enterprise buyers and partners evaluate the company.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Claude supports knowledge work, analysis, coding, and application development, creating multiple adoption routes within a
customer: employee usage, developer integration, and embedded workflow experiences.

Enterprise rollout materials indicate that implementation extends beyond configuration. Technical readiness, administrator
enablement, organizational launch, and sustained use all matter. Partners therefore need to be credible not just in AI
technology, but in practical enterprise transformation.

Anthropic must grow enterprise adoption in a competitive market while protecting a distinct posture on safety and
reliability. This likely creates shared decision-making among commercial, product, engineering, security, and policy
stakeholders.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The practical stakeholder environment spans:

- Partnerships and revenue leaders setting ecosystem priorities, partner coverage, and shared account strategy.
- Product and engineering teams seeking disciplined signal on customer friction, integration needs, and reusable patterns.
- Security, enterprise, and customer-facing functions shaping implementation expectations and risk controls.
- Cloud, technology, and services firms contributing reach, practitioner capacity, delivery expertise, and customer access.
- Customer technology leaders and business sponsors connecting AI programs to adoption, governance, and business value.

The role will likely need to translate across these groups without allowing technical standards or customer learning to become
fragmented by partner type or geography.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic presents Claude as an AI assistant designed to support secure and accurate work. Its broader company identity
makes architecture, controls, and customer trust inseparable from commercial adoption.

Relevant solution areas likely include enterprise knowledge workflows, software-development workflows, API-connected
applications, identity and access patterns, data boundaries, evaluation practices, and operational governance.

The strongest partner patterns will be reusable enough to speed customer work while remaining adaptable to each
organization’s systems, policies, users, and operating model. This creates a need for practical guidance rather than
generic AI evangelism.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic describes an ecosystem that includes cloud, technology, and services partners. Each category contributes a
different scaling mechanism:

- Cloud partners can provide infrastructure alignment, marketplace paths, and coordinated field access.
- Services firms can add delivery capacity, industry knowledge, and organizational-change expertise.
- Technology partners can extend Claude into established enterprise platforms and workflows.
- Joint offerings can turn broad AI interest into repeatable solutions for specific functions or industries.

Public positioning with Accenture around enterprise AI implementation signals that partner technical quality is central to
commercial expansion. The strategic need is not merely more partner logos; it is a partner base capable of producing
consistent customer outcomes.

A mature ecosystem motion requires enablement, qualification, technical assets, escalation paths, quality standards, and
structured learning from live customer work.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s recent market activity points to growing attention on systems-integrator relationships and enterprise-scale
implementation. This increases the need for partners that can carry AI programs from early exploration into operational
use across large organizations.

Enterprise adoption resources also signal that the market is moving beyond isolated experiments. Customers increasingly
need guidance on rollout, user behavior, governance, and durable operating practices.

Competitive pressure spans model providers, cloud platforms, and established enterprise-software vendors. Anthropic has an
opportunity to establish preferred partner patterns before customer architectures, platform choices, and service models
become difficult to displace.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Enterprise AI architecture connected to user adoption, governance, and measurable workflow value.
- Partner enablement designed to create durable delivery capacity, not one-off technical assistance.
- Ecosystem coordination across cloud providers, global consultancies, technology firms, and shared accounts.
- Repeatable solution patterns that balance speed, customer specificity, security, and operational quality.
- Technical-commercial leadership in ambiguous, fast-scaling platform environments.
- Disciplined field-to-product learning that turns deployment insight into roadmap and platform improvements.
- Responsible AI implementation practices that reinforce customer confidence while accelerating adoption.
- Executive communication across customer, partner, engineering, product, and commercial stakeholders.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s ecosystem appears to be an implementation engine, not simply a route for introductions or resale.
- The meaningful challenge is likely standardizing partner-led customer outcomes while preserving Anthropic’s technical and
  responsible-use standards.
- Claude’s enterprise positioning makes partner architecture, governance, and adoption capability commercially important.
- The relationship with Accenture suggests joint delivery patterns and practitioner readiness are strategic priorities.
- Anthropic’s rollout guidance creates a useful conversation around connecting technical deployment to organizational use.
- A multi-party ecosystem increases the value of leaders who can turn alliance objectives into practical operating models.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, scope, technical depth, leadership
experience, and partnership results must come from the governed resume and proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
